parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 10 to 100

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

parameters.name: ShareType
parameters.description: The type of the template. Valid values: Private and Public.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos list-template-versions --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --template-name describeinstances --max-results 50 --next-token H8xj9c-398djs9-39ajd9asdjjJ --share-type Private --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos ListTemplateVersions --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken 'H8xj9c-398djs9-39ajd9asdjjJ' --MaxResults 50 --TemplateName describeinstances --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ShareType Private
